messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled release wave 3: api=1.12.0 runtime=2.5.1 console=4.2.0 router=3.9.0 — change window starts 2026-03-20T22:00Z. Canary targets: /v1/generate, /v1/chat.

Tanvi-api: quick FYI — staging canary showed intermittent 504s from router -> runtime handshake during long-context tests. Not full failure but spike in tail latency.

Kevin-runtime: I saw that. Repro steps on staging: send convo with 12k tokens, then parallel warmup requests. Logs show repeated `handshake: KV_EVICT` warnings and a few `connection reset by peer`.

Kevin-runtime: snippet: ```
2026-03-20T18:03:12Z runtime[pid=24] WARN handshake: KV_EVICT mismatch: client=router-3.9.0 expected=evict=false got=evict=true
2026-03-20T18:03:12Z runtime[pid=24] ERROR grpc: stream reset by peer
```

Olivia-console: Console rollout is mostly config-only, but console -> router traces show router advertising `evict=true` capability. We didn't change eviction defaults in console. Might be router auto-negotiation.

Aaron-sre: Is this something that will blow up production or just noisy?

Tanvi-api: Canary traffic in prod-sim (5% routed) spiked tail p95 > 1.2s for generation endpoints. Not hard errors but degrades latency SLO. We care.

Maria-ops: Can we pause the wave until root cause triaged? Change window still open but we should avoid wide rollout if performance regresses.

Deploy-bot: Canary status: api=PASS, runtime=WARN, console=PASS, router=FAIL-HELD (3/5 canaries flagged). Auto-rollback policy: if router is flagged, hold and notify on-call.

Tanvi-api: Proposal: pin router to 3.8.4 for now (last known-good) and keep runtime 2.5.1 for canaries after pin. That buys time to debug negotiation.

Kevin-runtime: I can add a defensive downgrade path: runtime will accept `evict=true` but treat as advisory for 30s and not evict unless explicit policy header present. Patch small, but we should prefer pin on router for minimal impact.

Olivia-console: Agree with pin. Console won't be affected. I'll update release notes to indicate router pin and note the handshake caveat under Known Issues.

Aaron-sre: If we pin router, what's rollback plan if pin fails?

Tanvi-api: Rollback plan: 1) Pause wave (deploy-bot hold), 2) Roll router back to 3.8.4 cluster-by-cluster (15% intervals), 3) Monitor p50/p95 and handshake logs, 4) If degradation persists after full rollback, revert runtime to 2.5.0.

Maria-ops: I'll create the incident ticket and enable additional observability: extra sampler for long-context traces + kv-evict counters.

Deploy-bot: Action: holding wave. Owner: @tanvi-api to request router pin and ops to run rollback plan if pin fails. Canary timeout set 30m.

Tanvi-api: On it — pinging @neteng to pin router fleet to 3.8.4 and will post update here in 10m.

Kevin-runtime: I'll prepare the defensive runtime patch as a follow-up PR (target: post-pin quick patch). If pin goes bad, we can enable the advisory mode via config toggle.

Olivia-console: Draft release note line: "Router handshake negotiation: temporary pin to 3.8.4 due to KV eviction negotiation causing elevated tail latency on long-context workloads. Runtime advisory patch in flight."

Maria-ops: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-03. Adding SLO watchers and paging extra on-call if p95 > 1s.

Tanvi-api: Update: neteng acknowledged and started 3.8.4 pin. Will report back when first shard switches.

Deploy-bot: Canary update (10m): router=ROLLBACK_IN_PROGRESS (shard-1 15%), api=PASS, runtime=WARN. Monitoring p95 and handshake logs.

Aaron-sre: Thanks. Keep the wave held until we confirm p95 stable for 30m post-pin.

Tanvi-api: Will do. Will push final release notes after we confirm.

Olivia-console: Noting for product: we should add a small blurb in release notes and the postmortem if this surfaces again.

Kevin-runtime: Filing runtime PR now — branch `runtime/evict-advisory-mode`.

Tanvi-api: Closing loop: if pin restores p95 < 700ms for 30m, we resume wave and remove hold. If not, escalate to full rollback of runtime.

Maria-ops: Acknowledged.
